title: An oxygen changes neighbors
hook: Count the atoms and trace their bonds.

knows: Condensed structural formulas and covalent bonds.
doesNotKnow: Both structures have formula C₂H₆O, but their atoms connect differently. ethanol and dimethyl ether are constitutional isomers.

misconception: Different-looking structural drawings must represent different formulas or different compounds.
objective: Compare molecular formula and connectivity when classifying two structures.

claims.text: Structure A is ethanol (C₂H₆O); structure B is dimethyl ether (C₂H₆O). Both structures have formula C₂H₆O, but their atoms connect differently. ethanol and dimethyl ether are constitutional isomers.
Constitutional isomers have the same molecular formula but different atomic connectivity.
The diagrams show condensed connectivity, not stereochemistry or molecular geometry.
Recall: What relationship do ethanol and dimethyl ether have? Both structures have formula C₂H₆O, but their atoms connect differently. ethanol and dimethyl ether are constitutional isomers.
